學分抵免網路操作說明
Instructions for online credit transfer registration
請依照下列幾個步驟進行網路學分抵免作業
Please follow the steps to process on-line credit transfer.
1.登入校務資訊系統(請由樹德科技大學首頁的校務資訊系統連結或直接輸入校務資訊系統
網址)
Log onto the Information Integration System (either from STU University homepage, click on the
Information Integration System link or log onto the system directly. http://www.info.stu.edu.tw)
2.選擇「抵免學分申請」項目
Select the option of “Credit Transfer”
3.按下「進入抵免學分系統」
Click on “APPLY”.
4.逐一輸入擬申請的科目
Input course you have been officially advised are approved for exemption, one by one.
5.確認資料輸入無誤
Verify the data you have input.
6.確認後傳送
Submit your application.
7.列印抵免學分申請書
Print out the final roster.
8.登出校務資訊系統
Log out of the Information Integration System.
操作上如有任何疑問，請與系所辦公室或教務處聯絡。
If you have any problem while applying online, please contact the department office of your major.
輸入登入資料後開始作業
Enter your personal info and start the process
帳號(Account)為學號
User name is your STU student ID number.
密碼(Password)預設為身分證字號(外籍生或僑
生請輸入居留證號)
The default password is your Nationality ID.
For foreign students or compatriot students, the
default password is your Alien Resident
Certificate.

確認：確認輸入的抵免資料是否正確，請確定是否要傳送資料。
按下「確認」鍵後，資料即刻傳送，進入審核程序後將無法再做修改(不得新增或刪除)。
Confirm : Make sure all data you input is right before you submit. Once you click on the “Confirm”
button to submit your registration, no corrections or changes can be made.
再確認：請再次確認輸入的抵免資料是否正確，「確定」資料無誤後，一旦按下「確認」鍵
後，資料即刻傳送，進入審核程序後將無法再做修改(不得新增或刪除)。
Reconfirm: Please reconfirm the data you input before you submit. Once you click the “Confirm ”
button to submit your registration, no corrections or changes can be made.
列印後簽名，並連同1.抵免學分申請表2.歷年成績單，送至開課單位初審。
Print out the final roster and sign on it. Return all documents (inc. application form, transcript of
previous school and this final roster) to the department office of your major within the deadline.
